summary: This bill amends the Defense Production Act of 1950 to require the Chairperson of the Defense Production Act Committee to maintain a real-time, categorized database of actions taken under the Act, accessible to all Committee members.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Defense Production Act to require the Chairperson of the Defense Production Act Committee to maintain a database of actions. While creating and maintaining a database might incur some administrative costs, the bill itself does not directly authorize new spending programs or significantly alter existing spending levels. The financial impact would be minimal and incidental to the bill's primary purpose.
